plain: Harm that comes from how AI changes the incentives and institutions around it, with no misuser and no malfunctioning model to blame.
eli5: Every car on the road works fine and every driver is careful, and the town still ends up stuck in one giant traffic jam.
technical: Risk arising from multi-agent dynamics, incentives and institutional change in a world with AI, where no single actor or system is at fault; the fourth risk area in Shah et al. (2025), alongside misuse, mistakes and misalignment, and the “structure” in Zwetsloot and Dafoe’s accident, misuse and structure split (2019).
